en: Sepia-toned street scene showing a European city with a cobbled avenue, pedestrians in early-20th‑century clothing, and a tram running along the street. On the right stands a large Baroque church with an ornate, bulbous spire and clock, attached to a long building façade with many windows and shutters. On the left is a rounded corner building with elaborate decoration. The image has a narrow light border characteristic of vintage postcards.
